model.name: Clohessy–Wiltshire
model.text: The Clohessy–Wiltshire equations assume that the leader flies a circular orbit and that the follower stays close to it. That makes the motion linear, and six states are enough, the position and speed of the follower. In this case the follower starts 70 km above, 140 km ahead and 105 km to the side of a leader at 600 km of altitude.
model.eqNote: n is the constant orbital rate of the leader.

viewNote: Seen from the leader, the follower loops once per orbit around a point about 125 km ahead of it.
